name: Voxel-based Gaussian Splatting
definition: A novel volume representation where isometric 3D Gaussians are placed at voxel centers, enabling efficient CT volume extraction and differentiable X-ray rendering.
summary: Voxel-based Gaussian Splatting is a CT volume representation that fixes Gaussian positions to voxel centroids and removes view-dependent color to enable efficient, differentiable X-ray rendering.
